sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your proposal to agree the price basis for the coming period. We want to continue with you and confirm a binding volume of 23700 kg per year for 24 months.

Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We are prepared to make a longer-term commitment; please share your cost-breakdown XLSX so we can work through the underlying elements together. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose EUR 4.76 per kg, 30 days net, 24 months (term sheet attached).

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We welcome your commitment to a 24-month volume and have incorporated the verified index movements into our revised calculation.

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

For a contract of this duration, we must apply the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over 24 months is not possible. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. While company policy does not permit sharing our internal cost breakdown, we are confident this revised offer of EUR 5.30 per kg represents a fair market value.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. Alternatively, we offer a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer. We accept your AS-14404 price adjustment clause with no deadband, as your letter of 22 September proposed, and we move on price.

Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We propose EUR 4.87 per kg with your AS-14404 clause, 90 days net, 24 months (term sheet attached).

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause. 

Our main proposal features a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

As an alternative package, we can offer a reduction to EUR 5.10 per kg, provided we maintain the 30 days net payment terms, alongside a contract term of 24 months and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This alternative reflects a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
